loop.prompt: Locked-off camera, no camera movement, no zoom, photorealistic, constant lighting throughout with no flicker and no exposure change. The handmade cotton toy sits at the small marble café table under the Bologna arcade and reads its newspaper; after a moment it lowers the paper a little with one paw, lifts the tiny espresso cup with the other, takes a slow unhurried sip, sets the cup back on its saucer and returns to reading, content. The brioche stays on its plate untouched. A gentle evening breeze stirs the corner of the newspaper and its green felt collar; the hanging iron lanterns sway very slightly; a faint wisp of steam rises from the cup. The toy, the table, the chair and the arcade stay exactly as in the image; calm, slow, natural motion; no new objects, no people, no text; it ends in the same pose it starts in.
